seoTitle: About I Do Art Studios | Caricature Artist in Nigeria
seoDescription: Meet I Do Art Studios, home of Mr. Caricature. Discover our story, experience and live caricature entertainment across Nigeria and beyond.
heading: About I Do Art Studios
intro: Creating laughter, memories and unforgettable caricatures.
bodyParagraphs:
I Do Art Studios is a creative studio built around one simple idea: art should be an experience.

Led by celebrity visual artist Owolabi, popularly known as Mr. Caricature, the studio has helped make live caricature entertainment a memorable part of events across Nigeria and beyond.

What began as a passion for drawing grew into a specialized caricature brand known for expressive, spot-on caricatures that turn ordinary moments into something guests remember.

Owolabi is a self-taught artist who studied Accounting at Olabisi Onabanjo University before choosing to pursue a career in art. Today, his work has taken him across Nigeria and internationally, bringing live caricature entertainment to private celebrations, corporate events, brand activations and major social occasions.

Experience That Speaks for Itself

300+ Events

Live caricature experiences delivered across Nigeria and internationally, including events in the United Kingdom.
highlights: 300+ events covered across the UK, France, Spain and Nigeria
International Recognition  Owolabi is a member of the International Society of Caricature Artists (ISCA), a global community dedicated to the art and craft of caricature.

Pioneering Caricature Entertainment  I Do Art Studios has helped establish spot-on caricature entertainment as a distinctive live experience in Nigeria—combining drawing, interaction, laughter and a keepsake guests can take home.More Than Just a Drawing  At I Do Art Studios, we don't simply draw guests.  We create a moment around the drawing—the anticipation, the reveal, the laughter and the finished caricature that becomes a memorable keepsake.  From live event caricatures to commissioned artwork, our goal remains the same: to make people smile and give them something worth remembering.
